story_text: As a user, I want to set a priority level on a task so that I know what to work on first.

positive.title: Create task with each valid priority level
steps: 1. Create a task with priority set to LOW
2. Create a task with priority set to MEDIUM
3. Create a task with priority set to HIGH
positive.expected_result: 201 Created for each · priority stored and returned correctly

positive.title: Update task priority level
steps: 1. Create a task with priority set to LOW
2. Update the task's priority to HIGH

positive.title: Create a task without setting a priority level
steps: 1. Create a task without setting a priority level
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · default priority applied (e.g. MEDIUM) and reflected in response

negative.title: Create a task with an invalid priority level value
steps: 1. Attempt to create a task with an invalid priority level value (e.g., "INVALID_PRIORITY")
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message lists valid priority options

edge.title: Create task with priority as a number instead of a string
steps: 1. Attempt to create a task with a numeric priority value (e.g., 1)
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · numeric value not accepted
